title: SG-10.2.2 Scene applies the store's focused object as hover highlight and label
summary: BootScene subscribes to the game store focus value and shows it like hover
description: Context: gameStore already holds focusedObjectId and setFocusedObject (SG-10.2.1), and SceneObject.focus()/blur() already draw the same highlight and label as hover. BootScene does not read focusedObjectId yet. Desired behavior: the scene reads the store focus value on each store change, focuses the matching SceneObject, and clears focus when the value is null. Expected result: a unit test with Phaser mocked proves it. Why: so keyboard focus held in the store appears on the canvas.
acceptance_criteria: Given focusedObjectId is 'bookshelf' when the store changes then the SceneObject with spec.id 'bookshelf' has focus() called
Given focusedObjectId becomes null then every focused SceneObject has blur() called
A unit test with Phaser mocked covers both cases

in_scope: BootScene store subscription applies focusedObjectId to SceneObjects
out_of_scope: Writing focusedObjectId from the keyboard handler
preserve: Existing keyboard handling and focusChange event

technical_constraints: Reuse SceneObject.focus() and blur(); do not add new highlight code
Phaser 3.90; Phaser is mocked in unit tests
definition_of_done: Both requirements verified by passing unit tests
